subject: Staggered onboarding & term extension for MediSys private environments
messages:
From: Ashraf Khan <ashraf.khan@medisys.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; procurement@medisys.com
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@edgecloud.co>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Private env onboarding + term extension request

Hi Tessa,

We had our quarterly architecture review today and the execs want to accelerate our private footprint with Redwood. Specifically: add a second isolated VPC in us-west-2 for our R&D environments (network isolation + separate audit trail) and provision a small on-prem airgapped instance for the clinical analytics team. Given this would push our total committed capacity beyond the current renewal bands, we also want to talk through a 12-month term extension (to simplify billing and support).

Can you outline what the onboarding cadence looks like for a staggered rollout (west VPC first, on-prem later), and a rough delta in committed spend? Procurement is looped in for contract implications.

Appreciate a quick plan — timeline for proof-of-concept + expected cutover window.

Thanks,
Ashraf
Ashraf Khan
Director, Infrastructure
MediSys

[attachment: infra_network_diagram.png (png)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ashraf Khan <ashraf.khan@medisys.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medisys.com, Olivia Grant <olivia@edgecloud.co>
Date: 2026-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private env onboarding + term extension request

Hi Ashraf — thanks for the context and the diagram. Short answers up front, then a proposed cadence.

Quick summary:
- Staggered rollout: 1) VPC (us-west-2) for R&D as isolated environment (2 clusters, small burst pool), 2) On-prem airgapped node for clinical analytics (validated build + offline package).
- Timeline: PoC for the VPC in ~3 weeks, production cutover 6–8 weeks depending on network approvals. On-prem typically takes 8–12 weeks from PO due to procurement/shipping and onsite CA/ops.
- Term: our standard approach is a 12–18 month amendment for committed capacity that aligns billing and support windows; I can sketch a 12-month extension with a phased commit that maps to your rollout.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal scoping call (30m) — this week — to lock sequence and acceptance criteria.
2) Marcus to produce capacity delta + impact on SLA and cost.
3) Draft amendment (12-month term extension with phased commit) for procurement to review.

Marcus and Karthik — can you confirm the sizing assumptions I outlined below (we'll adjust after the call):
- R&D VPC: 2 dedicated clusters (p3-equivalent) scaled for 8k tokens/sec sustained; burst pool + nightly batch window.
- On-prem: 1 8-GPU rack (customer supplied networking) with offline key rotation process.

Ashraf / procurement — are there any firm blackout dates (upgrade freezes) in Sept/Oct? If so we'll avoid cutovers then.

I'll set a 30m call and include Marcus & Karthik.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0123

[signature: tessa_card_v2.png]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Ashraf Khan <ashraf.khan@medisys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, procurement@medisys.com
Date: 2026-08-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private env onboarding + term extension request

Tessa / Ashraf — attaching a first-pass capacity & cost delta. High-level notes:
- R&D VPC (us-west-2): two dedicated clusters, baseline commit + 25% burst. This maps to ~1.8x current commit for the private footprint.
- On-prem airgapped: capital-style line item (one-time setup) + a reduced monthly support T&M.
- Estimated uplift vs current spend (annualized): ~42% for year-1 if both environments are committed. A phased commitment that begins with a smaller baseline for VPC and steps up on go-live for on-prem reduces year-1 uplift to ~22%.

See attachment: capacity_delta_estimate.xlsx

I'll join the scoping call to walk through the assumptions.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

[attachment: capacity_delta_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: procurement@medisys.com
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>; Ashraf Khan <ashraf.khan@medisys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private env onboarding + term extension request

Thanks — a couple procurement items before we proceed:
1) Can you provide a contract amendment draft that: clearly phases the committed capacity (Milestone A: VPC baseline, Milestone B: on-prem acceptance), and ties invoicing to Milestone completion?
2) We need an updated SOC2 evidence pack for the on-prem support model and details about audit log separation for the isolated VPC.
3) Please include a one-page SLA addendum listing availability targets and escalation contacts for each environment.

Also: Do you offer a short pilot pricing for the VPC PoC that won’t count toward committed minimums, so we can validate traffic patterns? If yes, please state duration and limits.

Procurement (MediSys)
procurement@medisys.com

Appreciate the questions — short answers and next steps below.

1) Amendment draft: I'll share a 1-page term amendment (Milestone A/B phasing + invoicing tied to Milestone signoff) by EOD Monday. That will include pilot language.
2) SOC2 & audit logs: Evelyn will attach the updated evidence pack and a short note on how we treat audit separation for isolated VPCs (separate logging pipelines, per-VPC KMS keys).
3) SLA addendum: Karthik will draft the environment-specific SLA targets and escalation matrix.

Pilot: we can offer a 30-day pilot for the VPC PoC with a capped token allowance (250M tokens) that does not count toward committed minimums. If the pilot validates traffic and you opt to proceed, we roll the pilot consumption into Milestone A with a credit for unused tokens.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Marcus: finalize the capacity delta workbook with an alternate "phased commit" tab.
- Evelyn: attach SOC2 evidence and short writeup.
- Karthik: write SLA addendum draft.
- Tessa (me): draft term amendment & pilot language, set DocuSign routing for procurement.

I'll schedule a 30m scoping call for Monday 10:00 AM PT. If that doesn't work for your team, suggest times.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
